title: Ginkgo biloba cream for medicinal use
intro: Ginkgo biloba cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the leaves of the Ginkgo biloba tree, often combined with other natural ingredients. It is used in herbalism to support circulation and may help alleviate symptoms of conditions like peripheral neuropathy or poor blood flow. The cream is typically applied directly to the skin to promote localized healing and reduce inflammation. It is valued for its antioxidant properties and is believed to enhance overall skin health. This preparation is commonly used in alternative medicine for its potential to improve sensory function and reduce discomfort.
